python -c "
import hopsworks, warnings
from datetime import datetime, timezone
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
proj = hopsworks.login()
ds = proj.get_dataset_api()
# upload script
remote_dir = 'Resources'
up = ds.upload('data/heartbeat.py', remote_dir, overwrite=True)
print('UPLOADED', up)
app_path = 'Resources/heartbeat.py'
je = proj.get_jobs_api()
cfg = je.get_configuration('PYTHON')
cfg['appPath'] = app_path
job = je.create_job('heartbeat9ec611', cfg)
print('JOB CREATED', job.name, job.id)
sched = job.schedule(cron_expression='0 0 * ? * * *', start_time=datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc))
print('SCHEDULED', job.job_schedule)
" 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Upload script, create job, schedule hourly

tool_input.command:
python -c "
import hopsworks, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
proj = hopsworks.login()
je = proj.get_jobs_api()
job = je.get_job('heartbeat9ec611')
print('SCHEDULE', job.job_schedule)
ex = job.run(await_termination=True)
print('EXEC STATE', ex.get_state() if hasattr(ex,'get_state') else ex)
print('SUCCESS', getattr(ex,'success', None))
print('FINAL', getattr(ex,'final_status', None) or getattr(ex,'state', None))
" 2>&1 | tail -40

python -c "
import hopsworks, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
proj = hopsworks.login()
je = proj.get_jobs_api()
job = je.get_job('heartbeat9ec611')
sc = job.job_schedule
print('CRON', sc.cron_expression)
print('ENABLED', sc.enabled)
print('NEXT', getattr(sc,'next_execution_date_time', None))
execs = job.get_executions()
print('NUM_EXEC', len(execs))
print('LAST_STATE', execs[0].state if execs else None, getattr(execs[0],'final_status',None) if execs else None)
" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Verify schedule enabled and execution state
